title: LLM谈判中的跨语言人格效应
summary: 研究测试同一LLM谈判者在英语和韩语下的行为差异，发现提示定义的社会策略（如“固执”人格）在不同语言中效果不一致：韩语谈判达成协议率显著更高（77.3% vs 52.5%），主要因卖方让步更多、礼貌缓和语更多。
summary_en: The study tests whether prompt-defined personas produce consistent negotiation behavior across languages. Using identical Gemini 3.6 Flash buyer/seller agents across 12 CraigslistBargain scenarios in English and Korean, it finds agreement rates far higher in Korean (77.3% vs 52.5%), driven by larger seller concessions and more politeness mitigation, showing cross-lingual social-policy fidelity often fails.
